notes: «حدثاه» makes Abu Mu'awiya and Hafs co-transmitters at one level; «وحديث أبي معاوية، أتم» is a remark, not a route
Abdullah b. Mas'ud speaks inside Abd al-Rahman's account («فقال عبد الله»), so he is the last link
The second group is the Amash's own second isnad («فحدثني معاوية بن قرة عن أشياخه»); its unnamed shaykhs stay unnamed
